design_rationale: The design combines deep, trustworthy navy with warm gold accents to convey both authority and human warmth. Modern serif typography paired with clean geometric layouts creates premium sophistication while maintaining accessibility. Generous whitespace and soft shadows create an approachable, professional environment where clients feel supported during difficult times.

sections.name: hero
sections.layout: Full-width background image with centered text overlay. Left-aligned content block on desktop, center-aligned on mobile.
sections.background: Linear gradient overlay from rgba(26, 58, 82, 0.65) to rgba(15, 31, 46, 0.75) over a high-resolution photography background
sections.image_style: Professional office environment with diverse professionals in conversation; warm natural lighting suggesting trust and competence. Alternative: confident client in consultation meeting. Tone: warm, human, supportive rather than austere.
sections.text_position: left, vertically centered with 15% top offset on desktop; center-aligned on mobile
sections.cta_style: Primary button paired with secondary outline button. Primary button: 'Get Your Free Consultation' with arrow icon. Secondary: 'Learn About Our Practice'. Buttons stacked on mobile.

sections.name: practice_areas
sections.layout: 3-column grid on desktop, 1-column on tablet, single stack on mobile. Cards have equal height with flexbox alignment.

card_style.hover_effect: Lift shadow to '0 12px 32px rgba(26, 58, 82, 0.12)' and translate up 4px on hover. Left border accent color (4px solid #d4a574) appears on hover.
card_style.icon_style: 60x60px icons in gold (#d4a574), minimalist line-style SVGs centered above title. Icons represent: scales (litigation), handshake (settlement), medical briefcase (claims).

sections.name: why_choose_us
sections.layout: Split layout: 50/50 on desktop. Left side features large hero image (400x500px, border-radius 8px) of professional female lawyer in office. Right side contains h2 headline, body text, and 4 benefit bullets with small gold icons (24x24px) to the left of each line.
elements: Large testimonial-style stat: '15+ Years Combined Experience' in h2 weight, primary color
Bullet list with subtle gold left border (3px)
Subheading in accent color above main headline

sections.name: testimonials
sections.layout: Carousel/slider layout on desktop (showing 2 cards side-by-side with 2rem gap), single card on mobile. Each card scrollable with navigation dots at bottom center.

card_style.quote_style: 5-star rating display (gold stars, 1.25rem size) above quote. Opening quote character (') in 4rem gold, opacity 0.2 as background decoration. Client name in bold body weight below quote. Title/relation in caption text, secondary color.

sections.name: process
sections.layout: Vertical timeline on mobile, horizontal 4-step process on desktop. Steps connected by subtle line (1px solid #e5ddd5). Circle numbered badges (60px diameter) in primary color with white text, positioned at line intersection points.

card_style.hover_effect: Text color shifts to primary_dark, subtle underline appears beneath step title

sections.name: cta_section
sections.layout: Full-width horizontal band. Centered text with h2 headline and supporting subheading text (max 600px). Two button options below (primary + secondary) stacked on mobile, side-by-side on desktop.
sections.background: Solid primary color (#1a3a52) with subtle radial gradient accent from top-right corner: radial-gradient(circle at 85% 15%, rgba(212, 165, 116, 0.15) 0%, transparent 50%)
sections.button_style: Primary button inverted: white text on gold background (#d4a574) with hover state darkening to #b8935f. Secondary button: white border (2px) with white text, background transparent, hover fills with white text becoming primary color.

sections.name: footer
sections.layout: 4-column grid on desktop (Company Info | Practice Areas | Resources | Contact), 2-column on tablet, single column on mobile. Top section contains logo and tagline. Bottom section contains copyright bar with light background.
sections.background: Footer main: primary_dark (#0f1f2e). Copyright bar: darker shade #0a1419 with border-top 1px solid rgba(212, 165, 116, 0.2)

button_primary.hover: Background darkens to #0f1f2e, shadow expands to '0 8px 20px rgba(26, 58, 82, 0.3)', cursor pointer. Subtle 2px transform scale to 1.02.

button_secondary.hover: Background fills with primary color (#1a3a52), text remains same color, border maintains. Box-shadow: '0 4px 12px rgba(26, 58, 82, 0.15)'

mobile_adjustments: Hero section height reduces to 70vh, text alignment centers, h1 reduces to 2.25rem
Practice areas switches from 3-column to single-column stack, cards maintain padding but adjust width to full container
Why choose us layout becomes single-column: image displays at top (full width, 300px height), text content below
Testimonial carousel shows single card at 100% width, navigation arrows positioned outside card
Process timeline becomes vertical orientation with circles positioned to left of content block, connecting line becomes vertical (1px wide)
Section padding reduces from 5rem to 2.5rem top/bottom, 1.5rem left/right
Button pairs in CTAs stack vertically with full width, 12px gap between
Footer columns compress from 4 to 2 on tablet, 1 on mobile with 2rem gap between sections
H1 typography reduces to 2.25rem, H2 to 1.75rem, body text maintains 1rem but line-height stays 1.6
Container max-width respected but padding ensures safe margins on small viewports
